answers.name: Gibberellic acid
answers.blurb: A plant hormone first found in a fungus that made rice seedlings grow absurdly tall, the "foolish seedling" disease in Japan. Growers spray it on seedless grapes to make them bigger.

answers.name: Ethylene
answers.blurb: The simplest plant hormone is a gas: ripening fruit gives off ethylene, which makes the fruit around it ripen too. That's why one banana in the fruit bowl speeds everything else up.
